default_volume.label: Default volume
default_volume.description: Volume for mpv playback, 0-100. Used on play and until the widget, panel or launcher changes it.

search_limit.label: Results per list
search_limit.description: How many episodes to show per podcast and how many iTunes results to fetch, 3-30.

mpv_bin.label: mpv binary
mpv_bin.description: mpv executable used for headless playback. Change only if mpv is not on PATH.

mpris.label: MPRIS integration
mpris.description: Expose playback to the desktop media player (Noctalia media widget, playerctl) via mpv-mpris when its script is found.

mpris_path.label: mpv-mpris path
mpris_path.description: Custom path to mpris.so. Empty means auto-detect in ~/.config/mpv/scripts and /usr/lib/mpv-mpris.

podcast_feeds.label: RSS feeds
podcast_feeds.description: Extra podcast RSS URLs, always subscribed alongside the ones added in the panel.

podindex_key.label: Podcast Index key
podindex_key.description: API key from podcastindex.org. Enables Podcast Index search next to iTunes. Empty disables it.

podindex_secret.label: Podcast Index secret
podindex_secret.description: API secret from podcastindex.org. Needed together with the key.

max_length.label: Episode name length
max_length.description: Maximum characters of the episode name shown in the bar, 5-60.
